$comment: P69 (lane `cs`, D-CSUBSET-GNUC-PREDEFINE-SELECTS-UNIMPLEMENTED-BUILTIN): a NaN's PAYLOAD survives every constant spelling of it, in every floating format. `__builtin_nan`/`nanf`/`nanl` place the payload in the low fraction bits with the quiet bit set; a NaN converted between formats keeps the fraction's TOP bits; folded arithmetic with a NaN operand returns the first NaN operand, its sign and payload kept. Each target's `long double` is identified from the bytes of 1.0L (DSS ships no <float.h> yet: D-C-FLOAT-H-AND-FLOAT-PREDEFINES-MISSING) and checked against its own bytes: x87 80-bit on ELF x86_64, binary128 on ELF aarch64, binary64 on PE and Mach-O. Until this row a nonzero payload in an 80/128-bit long double constant was refused, and every 80/128-bit NaN packed as the canonical one. The exit code is a bitmask of the groups that misbehaved (see main.c). MEASURED 2026-10-01 through `dssharness run probe-reference-cc`, this file: gcc 13.3.0 and clang 18.1.3 at -std=c17 -pedantic-errors and -std=c2x (x87, run 20261001-152133-2ab5ecf3), mingw-w64 gcc 13.2.0 in both modes (x87, run 20261001-152157-294a87c4), MSVC 19.51 (no `__GNUC__`: a bare 42, run 20261001-152158-c2cfddb3) and AppleClang 21.0.0 in both modes (binary64, macos-arm64-release, run 20261001-152153-a564cdab) all exit 42; the binary128 bytes are aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc 13.3.0's and clang 18.1.3's (--target=aarch64-linux-gnu) own assembly (run 20261001-044457-d0d46a44). AppleClang 21 at -std=c2x refuses NaN arithmetic in a static initializer (`cannot compile this static initializer yet`, run 20261001-045100-286c33f9), so that group runs where long double is wider than double. The release arm is REPORT-ONLY.
